summary: Retain runtime for Location.replace navigation without preserving the current entry for back traversal.

target.notes: Parse/resolve the URL and perform replace-style navigation so the current session-history entry is replaced according to navigation rules.

caveats: assign and replace are observably different through back/forward history.

tests.name: replace initiates navigation
tests.expected_behavior: navigates to resolved /next using replacement behavior

tests.name: current entry is not retained like assign
tests.expected_behavior: back traversal does not expose the replaced entry as assign normally would
